lead: A team of agents fits on one page: the decision from lesson 1 and, for each role, level, tools, what it writes, isolation, input, return, who verifies it, and cap. Written this way, a script checks whether a field is missing or whether two roles write to the same place without isolation. In this lesson you write your loop's time.md, check it, and run it.
objetivo: write your loop's time.md (role, level, tools, file owner, isolation, return, verification, cap) and run it.

aprende.t: The eight fields of each role
File owner: who writes where, and isolated how
A checker that flags missing fields and collisions
The course map and your plan with dates

hero_alt: Dark board with blank white cards pinned in a tree, connected by threads, under a desk lamp.

secoes.sub: Each step uses a lesson from the course. Click to see which one.

nos.detalhe: Run the matrix. If it says "direto", your team is one agent and the time.md has a single role. If it says híbrido, write down what stays in sequence and what goes in parallel.
Few roles, each with a verifiable output: who plans, who does, who checks by code, who reviews by model. Level by role (smallest, executor, top, super), never by model name.
For each role that writes: in which folders and with what isolation (worktree or sandbox). Two roles writing to the same place without isolation is the lost write from lesson 5; the checker flags it.
Each role has someone who verifies it: a criteria script, a reviewer without write access, or you at a gate. No role verifies itself.
Rounds and time per role. The round cap for the generator × evaluator loop; the per-item timeout holds the fan-out. The cap on cycles and memory for the whole loop is course 2.

secoes.legenda: Start with the smallest team that does the job. A new role only comes in when you can say what it returns and who checks it.

secoes.sub: Copy the template, swap in your loop's roles, and run the checker. No model is called.

blocos.conteudo:
# Time do loop — [nome do loop]

Decisão (aula 1): híbrido — plan and review at the center; run in parallel only the independent items.

## papel: planejador
- nível: topo
- ferramentas: Read, Grep, Glob
- escreve em: nada
- isolamento: nenhum (read-only)
- entrada: goal.md
- retorno: plan in up to 5 steps + comando → saída criteria (the orchestrator is the one who writes to plans/)
- verificado por: you (human gate before running)
- teto: 1 round

## papel: executor
- nível: executor
- ferramentas: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob
- escreve em: src/ tests/novos/
- isolamento: worktree
- entrada: approved plan
- retorno: list of changed files + test output
- verificado por: avaliador
- teto: 3 rounds, 600 s each

## papel: avaliador
- nível: menor
- ferramentas: Read, Bash, Grep, Glob
- escreve em: nada
- isolamento: sandbox read-only
- entrada: goal.md + diff + test output
- retorno: OK/FALHA per criterion + APROVADO or FALTA
- verificado por: script verificar.mjs
- teto: 1 round per delivery

## papel: revisor-codex
- nível: executor
- ferramentas: codex exec -s read-only
- escreve em: nada
- isolamento: sandbox read-only
- entrada: same briefing + real diff
- retorno: up to 6 lines, the last one APROVADO or FALTA
- verificado por: you reconcile (aceito, rejeitado with evidence, em aberto)
- teto: 2 rounds

abas.html:
papéis: 4 · problemas: 0
saída: 0

The template passes. The planner writes "nada": the orchestrator is the one that saves the plan to disk. In the first version of the template, the planner said "escreve em: plans/" with read-only tools, and the checker flagged the contradiction.

abas.rot: Common mistake: two executors in the same folder
abas.html:
The same team with the executor without a worktree and a second executor, with no cap, also writing to src/:

executor-2: falta teto
colisão: src/ tem 2 donos sem isolamento (executor, executor-2)
papéis: 5 · problemas: 2
saída: 1

Two ways out: give each executor a worktree (lesson 5) or split the folders by owner (what the agent teams doc asks for).

secoes.sub: Your team on paper, checked, and one real round.

exercicios.titulo: E17 · The time.md for your loop
exercicios.texto: Run the matrix (lesson 1) for the loop you want to build. Write the time.md with the roles the decision calls for, replace [nome do loop], and run the checker.
exercicios.pronto: python3 confere-time.py time.md; echo "saída: $?" → papéis: N · problemas: 0 and saída: 0, with N equal to the number of roles you wrote.

exercicios.titulo: E18 · One round of the team
exercicios.texto: Pick a small task from your project. Write the goal with 2 or 3 criteria and commit it. The executor runs through gera-avalia.sh in a worktree (git worktree add) and the Codex reviewer reads the diff through the bridge. Reconcile the findings in revisao.md.
exercicios.pronto: ./gera-avalia.sh goal.md "[pedido]" ends with → APROVADO and saída: 0; the last line of the review starts with APROVADO or FALTA:; grep -cE "^(aceito|rejeitado|aberto):" revisao.md equals the number of findings.

resultado.texto: A team of agents sized to the work, written on one page, checked by script and run once for real.

rolagem_fim.texto: Decide, delegate and check, isolate, and build your team. Only move on to the next deliverable when the "done when" of the previous one is true.

secoes.legenda: Mandatory order: a team without isolation repeats the lost write, and a team without an evaluator goes back to trusting the generator's "done".

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

perguntas.p: The matrix from lesson 1 said "direct" for your loop. What does time.md look like?
opcoes: With four roles, to be safe
With a single role (and whoever verifies it)
With one role per model you have
perguntas.explica: The smallest team that does the job. A new role comes in when you know what it returns and who checks it.

perguntas.p: The checker flagged "colisão: src/ tem 2 donos sem isolamento". What are the fixes?
opcoes: A worktree for each executor, or split the folders by owner
perguntas.explica: It's the lost write from lesson 5, seen on paper before it happens.

perguntas.p: Why is the "verificado por" field required for every role?
opcoes: Because no role verifies itself: the generator's "done" doesn't decide
perguntas.explica: Lesson 4: someone else decides, a different process looking at the artifact. Without this field, the team goes back to trusting the report.

perguntas.p: In the model, the planner writes "nada". Who writes the plan to disk?
opcoes: The orchestrator (the main session or the script)
perguntas.explica: The planner only has read tools. Saying it writes to plans/ was the contradiction the checker caught in the first version.

itens.texto: Decision and, per role: level, tools, where it writes, isolation, input, return, verification and cap.
A missing field, a meaningless level and two owners without isolation show up before you run anything.
Executor in a worktree, evaluator by code, cross-review reconciled.
